findings.text: the recorded negative control (typography-revert-control.log) reddens on the size assertion at :63 and never reaches the two caption assertions at :64-65, so the guard that the explanation is out of the image has no on-record red state even though it is falsifiable; restoring the suptitle at 14x7.2 in would redden :65 because matplotlib emits titles as XML comments (the committed SVG carries '<!-- edit 12 +6% converged -->').

clipped_labels and overlapping_labels are recorded as 0 after both render drivers reset visual_inspection to {'pending': True}, and verify_typography.py asserts them by reading that same receipt field, so no measurement recorded at 0c9e5609e could have contradicted a clipped or overlapping label; the 0/0 values were re-entered by hand after the render.

the panel subcommand builds its --receipt document from panel['display_map'] alone, so the caption returned at :2415 is printed but never persisted on that path, unlike the run command which writes the whole panel dict; a receipt written by 'panel --receipt' therefore cannot carry the page explanation that is now the only place the measurements are recorded.
